item.title: Missoulians protest deadly ICE shooting in Minnesota
item.description: While some held signs expressing anger towards the federal agency, others showed up to grieve Renee Nicole Good, who was fatally shot Wednesday in Minneapolis.

item.title: Fourth Democratic candidate running for Montana U.S. Senate seat
item.description: Alani Bankhead says she spent much of her career investigating crimes like human trafficking and child sexual abuse, including time with the Hawaii Attorney General’s office.

item.title: 'A lot of good times in that house:' Couple picking up pieces after Ninemile house fire
item.description: A Ninemile couple spent years building their dream house with their family and friends. After a December house fire, those same family members and friends are helping them rebuild.
